text:
priya_cs: Heads up — renewal amendment for Nexwell is due next week. Procurement wants split invoicing across two legal entities AND a 6-month term instead of annual. They also asked for onboarding to start immediately once PO is issued. Need internal alignment on pricing and PO path.
mike_sales: cc @dina_legal @sam_fin. Do we have a precedent for one SOW with multiple billing entities? :thinking_face:
dina_legal: We have one precedent but it required separate billing lines on the SOW and separate invoice metadata. Also required explicit countersign if tax/withholding terms change. We can do it but it adds bookkeeping for finance.
sam_fin: Procurement will insist on a PO (net30) + vendor code. If they want 6mo term we either lose the annual discount or apply a small premium. Rough calc: 6mo = annual price * 0.54 (vs 0.5), so ~8% uplift effective vs advertised annual pro‑rate. Need final pricing from Product.
olivia_cs: Enablement note — customer expects kickoff before amendment is fully countersigned. We can provision view-only access and run pre-onboarding sessions, but full seats + SSO setup blocked until contract signed.
priya_cs: Customer offered a compromise: 6mo term at +4% (on net compared to straight pro‑rate) + keep two onboarding credits. If Product ok, I'll push PO template and DocuSign amendment.
jonas_product: +4% acceptable. Keep 2 enablement seats and 8 hours of onboarding support included. We should flag this as a non-standard term in the renewal tracker.
mike_sales: OK drafting message to Nexwell with PO template and amendment link. I'll include the vendor code field and invoice examples.
renewal-bot: Reminder — renewal for account:nexwell in 6 days. Action items: pricing approval, PO template, DocuSign amendment link.
mike_sales: Sent to customer at 1725010005 — included PO template, example invoice metadata, and DocuSign link. Asking for PO + signed amendment. Tracking in CRM.
priya_cs: Thanks. I'll hold enablement in staging until we get signed amendment/PO. If procurement uploads PO first, we can start partial onboarding as discussed.
mike_sales: Will follow up EOD if no response. :thumbsup:

---

Sample invoice metadata to include in PO (shared with customer):
```
Billing line A:
- entity: Nexwell Inc (EIN: 12-3456789)
- scope: US seats, onboarding credits
Billing line B:
- entity: Nexwell EMEA (VAT: GB987654321)
- scope: EU seats
Vendor code: NEX-001
Payment terms: Net30 (PO required)
```

mike_sales: attaching DocuSign template link: https://docusign.example.com/abcd1234 (internal tracking id: RENEW-1725).
